description: Analogue oscillator with four waveform outputs and a wavefolder

params.text: Sets the fundamental frequency of the oscillator, and so the pitch of every output
Tunes the frequency finely around the setting of the COARSE knob
Sets the depth of linear frequency modulation from the LIN FM input
Attenuates the wavefold CV input before it sums with the WAVEFOLD fader
Sets how far the oscillator's sine wave is folded, a plain sine at the left and a dense harmonic timbre at the right

inputs.text: Sets the pitch at a volt per octave, summed with the COARSE and FINE knobs
Linear frequency modulation, scaled by the LIN FM attenuator
A rising edge above 2.5V resets the oscillator's cycle
Modulates the amount of folding, scaled by the CV attenuator and summed with the WAVEFOLD fader

outputs.text: Square wave at the oscillator's fundamental frequency
Sawtooth wave at the oscillator's fundamental frequency
Triangle wave at the oscillator's fundamental frequency
Sine wave at the oscillator's fundamental frequency
The oscillator's sine wave after the wavefolder, shaped by the WAVEFOLD fader and its CV

inputs.0: 1V per octave · continuous · one channel only
inputs.2: high above 2.5V · stepped · one channel only
